title: Algebra 2: Radical Functions & Equations
tagline: Put variables under radicals and into rational exponents, rationalize like a pro, graph radical functions, and solve equations without falling for phantoms.

chapters.title: Rational Exponents with Variables
chapters.description: Convert between radical and exponent form with variables, run the exponent rules on fractions, and simplify variable radicands.

chapters.title: Rationalizing & Radical Arithmetic
chapters.description: Clear radicals out of denominators — monomial and binomial — and run FOIL on radical binomials with conjugates as the finishing move.

chapters.title: Radical Functions: Graphs & Domains
chapters.description: Meet the square-root parent function, solve for domains with one inequality, and apply the full transformation toolkit to radical graphs.

chapters.title: Solving Radical Equations
chapters.description: Isolate and square, hunt down extraneous solutions, clear radicals from both sides, and learn why odd powers never lie.

chapters.title: Rational-Exponent Equations & Models
chapters.description: Solve power equations with reciprocal exponents, handle the even-numerator plus-minus, and put radical formulas to work on skids, drops, and pendulums.
